The tail +0x8c..+0xe8 is byte-identical, 24 words, including `li r6,1`@+0xc4 and `mulli r0,r6,36`@+0xc8, so r6 is idx's home in BOTH streams and the `end:` label at +0xc8 reads it. hypothesis.statement: Mechanism (ii) is not reachable from any spelling of the SAME construct, so the next lane must change the CONSTRUCT, not the spelling: the remaining untried source axis is to remove the `idx` local from the else-arm call entirely by making the two sprintf sites pass a value the front end cannot constant-fold -- concretely, hoist the two-armed call into ONE call site after the if/else (`sprintf(buf, slotFormat, n + 1, arg)` with `arg` assigned in each arm), so the 4th argument is a merged phi rather than a literal 0 on the else path. If retail's r6 liveness is the shadow of a single merged call site, the second `li r6,0` disappears and, paired with probe B, the function closes at 59/59.
